verdict.rationale: The Needle README documents its own grammar-constrained decoding: you declare a shape, pass in messy text and get typed fields back, with 'the decode grammar guarantees the output parses'. A community user also reported a clean JSON doc from a multi-action request. The evidence is a single short README mention, so the depth of the feature is unproven. missing for 10: explicit JSON/JSON-schema format documentation, user-supplied custom grammars (e.g. GBNF), grammar constraints exposed through the OpenAI-compatible serving API, detailed reference docs, independent corroboration of the parse guarantee.

support.subject: As a developer, I can constrain model output to structured formats like JSON using grammars

citations.quote: declare a shape, hand over messy text, get typed fields back... The decode grammar guarantees the output parses
Asking it to both turn up the home temperature and turn down the living room lights produced a clean JSON doc.
